# Aqua Lagoon

> Aqua Lagoon is a swimming pool and wellness centre in Kayamkulam, Kerala, India. It offers swimming lessons and coaching for kids and adults, open/lane swimming, yoga and zumba classes, and a mini auditorium for events. Website: https://aqualagoon.in

## About

- Type: Swimming pool & wellness centre (SportsActivityLocation)
- Location: Kayamkulam, Kerala, India (PIN 690537)
- Areas served: Kayamkulam, Mavelikkara, Alappuzha, Oachira, Haripad, Kattanam, Krishnapuram, Karthikappally, Nooranad, Bharanikkavu, Thamarakulam, Cheppad, Karuvatta and Chengannur
- Certified coaches, small batches, lifeguarded and temperature-controlled pool

## Services

- Open Swimming — day passes and memberships for lane swims and family sessions
- Learn to Swim — structured lessons and coaching for kids and adults, free trial for first-timers
- Yoga classes — mat and aqua yoga for all levels
- Zumba dance fitness — high-energy group cardio
- Mini Auditorium — hourly-booked hall for birthdays, workshops and functions
